description: Run the original functions on generated edge-case inputs (non-ASCII, emoji, -0, NaN, ...) plus optional extra inputs, and save the results as cases.jsonl: the behavior the port must match.

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

device.description: Android device serial; picked automatically when only one is connected.

float_tolerance.description: Numeric code: floats match when they differ by at most this times the larger magnitude (absolute below 1), e.g. 1e-9. Saved with the crate for diff and gate; 0 removes it.

inputs.description: JSONL file of extra cases: {"fn": name, "args": [...]}.

module.description: JS only: import the original from this JS module instead of the TS source.

pin_clock.description: TS/JS (napi) and Python: true pins the clock and random numbers while recording and diffing (`Date.now()`, `new Date()`, `Math.random`; `time.time`, `datetime.now`, `random`) to the values in pinned.json, and writes src/port/pinned.rs for the port to read them (`mod pinned;` in port.rs). Kept for later runs; false stops pinning.

profile.description: Record on this machine (default) or on a connected Android device (JVM crates).

resolve_from.description: Resolve npm packages from this folder's node_modules.

test_command.description: TS/JS or Python: also record every call the original's own test suite makes to the unit's functions, e.g. ["npx", "jest"] or ["pytest"]. Runs in the original's folder.

name: record
title: Record original behavior
